facts.text: I am looking for advice on painting metal surfaces for a model kit.
I recently finished a Tamiya 1/48 scale Spitfire Mk.V model kit.
I had to learn new techniques to paint the Tamiya 1/48 scale Spitfire Mk.V.
I am not entirely happy with the results of my painting on the Tamiya 1/48 scale Spitfire Mk.V.
I did not think to use a wet palette.
I have been using a clear coat to try to achieve a metallic sheen on a model.
I have been using a cheap airbrush.
I am thinking of upgrading to a good airbrush.
I have been experimenting with Vallejo acrylics.
I have been experimenting with AK Interactive weathering products.
I am curious about the difference between enamel washes and acrylic washes for weathering effects.
I am curious to know more about using enamel washes versus acrylic washes for weathering effects.
I am thinking of trying out enamel washes on my next project.
My next project is a 1/72 scale B-29 bomber.
I want recommendations for enamel washes that work well with acrylic paints.
